## Verdict
accepted

## Concerns
- claim-1 is correct provided \(I_{r,q}\) is the homogeneous box-truncation ideal and \(A_+=\bigoplus_{d>0}A_d\). The case \(q=0\) is handled.
- claim-2 is correct conditional on the established Schur \(\mathbb Z\)-spanning description of \(J_v\). The ideal property alone ensures \(h_ks_\mu\in J_v\), while the spanning description is needed to conclude these products generate \(A_+J_v\).
- Bars should be retained formally for classes in \(A\), though their omission is harmless when explicitly understood.
